description:
Query HD wallet data for EVM blockchains by extended public key (xPub). The wallet must first be synced via manage_hd_wallet. Offset pagination: use 'limit' and 'offset' for paged results.

Actions:
• derive-receiving-address: Derive the next unused receiving address
• list-addresses: List all derived addresses for the wallet
• list-transactions: List transactions across all wallet addresses
• prepare-transaction: Build an unsigned EVM transaction from a wallet address
• list-assets: List token balances (ERC-20, ERC-721, etc.) held by the wallet
• get-details: Get wallet summary (total balance, address count, sync status)

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• derive-receiving-address: 24
• get-details: 12
• list-addresses: 12
• list-assets: 12
• list-transactions: 120
• prepare-transaction: 24

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

blockchain.description: EVM blockchain (e.g. ethereum, binance-smart-chain, polygon); required for all actions

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

data.description: Hex-encoded calldata for contract interaction (prepare-transaction only)

feePriority.description: Fee priority level (prepare-transaction only; defaults to standard)

limit.description: Max results per page (for list-* actions)

network.description: Network (e.g. mainnet, sepolia); required for all actions

value.description: Amount in the native coin's smallest unit, e.g. wei (required for prepare-transaction)

name: hd_wallet__hd_wallet_data_evm
